hagia-sophia.name: Hagia Sophia
hagia-sophia.price_text: Entry fee for visitors; price changes often — check on the day
hagia-sophia.hours: Open daily; closed to visitors during prayer times
hagia-sophia.tip: Go right at opening to beat the queues. Dress modestly and cover hair if you are a woman.

topkapi.name: Topkapi Palace
topkapi.price_text: Ticket plus separate Harem ticket; check current prices on the day
topkapi.hours: Usually Tue–Sun, roughly 09:00–17:00; closed one weekday — check on the day
topkapi.tip: Buy the Harem add-on; it is the best part. Allow at least half a day.
topkapi.best: Morning, before the tour groups arrive

blue-mosque.name: Blue Mosque
blue-mosque.hours: Open daily outside the five prayer times
blue-mosque.tip: Visit between prayers. Carry a scarf; shoes come off at the door.

basilica-cistern.name: Basilica Cistern
basilica-cistern.price_text: Paid entry; check the current ticket price on the day
basilica-cistern.hours: Daily, roughly 09:00–19:00 — check on the day
basilica-cistern.tip: Cool and dim inside — a good break on a hot afternoon. Look for the Medusa heads at the far end.
basilica-cistern.best: Hot midday or a rainy day

galata-tower.name: Galata Tower
galata-tower.price_text: Paid entry; check on the day
galata-tower.hours: Daily, usually until evening — check on the day
galata-tower.tip: The narrow balcony gets crowded. Go early or near closing for the best city view.

grand-bazaar.name: Grand Bazaar of Istanbul
grand-bazaar.price_text: Free to enter; you pay for what you buy
grand-bazaar.tip: Haggle politely and walk away if the price feels wrong. Know your price before you start.

dolmabahce.name: Dolmabahce Palace
dolmabahce.price_text: Paid entry; separate tickets for the Selamlik and Harem sections
dolmabahce.hours: Tue–Sun, roughly 09:00–16:00; closed Monday — check on the day
dolmabahce.tip: Entry is by timed guided tour. Arrive early and bring your passport for security.

suleymaniye.name: Suleymaniye Mosque
suleymaniye.tip: The terrace behind the mosque has one of the best free views over the Golden Horn.

maidens-tower.name: Maiden's Tower
maidens-tower.price_text: Small boat fare plus tower entry; check on the day
maidens-tower.hours: Daily; boats run from the Üsküdar shore — check times on the day
maidens-tower.tip: The view from the Üsküdar shore at sunset is free and just as good as going up.

rumeli-fortress.name: Rumeli Fortress
rumeli-fortress.price_text: Paid entry; check on the day
rumeli-fortress.hours: Usually Tue–Sun; closed one weekday — check on the day
rumeli-fortress.tip: Steep steps and uneven ground — wear good shoes. Combine it with a Bosphorus boat trip.

ataturk-stadium.name: Ataturk Olympic Stadium
ataturk-stadium.price_text: Match tickets vary; stadium tours only on event days — check on the day
ataturk-stadium.hours: Only on match or event days
ataturk-stadium.tip: It is far from the centre. Go only for a match and plan the trip back in advance.

balat.name: Balat
balat.hours: Always open; cafés and shops daytime
balat.tip: Walk the coloured houses and side streets on a weekday morning. It gets busy at weekends.

beylerbeyi.name: Beylerbeyi Palace
beylerbeyi.price_text: Paid entry; check on the day
beylerbeyi.hours: Tue–Sun, roughly 09:00–16:00; closed Monday — check on the day
beylerbeyi.tip: Quieter than Dolmabahce. Combine it with a walk along the Asian shore.

bosphorus-bridge.name: Bosphorus Bridge
bosphorus-bridge.price_text: Free to see; no pedestrian crossing
bosphorus-bridge.tip: Best seen from a Bosphorus boat or from the Ortaköy waterfront. You cannot walk across.

bosphorus-cruise.name: Bosphorus Cruise
bosphorus-cruise.price_text: Short trips from a few hundred TRY; long tours cost more — check on the day
bosphorus-cruise.hours: Boats run daily from Eminönü and other piers; times vary
bosphorus-cruise.tip: Take the short public ferry rather than a private tour if you want to save money.

bosporus.name: Bosporus
bosporus.price_text: Free to view; boat trips cost extra
bosporus.tip: The waterfront at Ortaköy or Arnavutköy is a good free spot to watch the boats.

chora.name: Chora Mosque
chora.price_text: Free or small entry fee — check on the day
chora.tip: The mosaics are the highlight. Go in the morning for better light.

eyup-sultan.name: Eyüp Sultan Mosque
eyup-sultan.tip: A calm, local mosque away from the crowds. Ride the cable car up to Pierre Loti for the view.

fatih-mosque.name: Fatih Mosque
fatih-mosque.tip: Visit the market streets around it for a real local feel.

galata-bridge.name: Galata Bridge
galata-bridge.tip: Walk the lower level for the fish restaurants and the view of the fishermen above.

gulhane-park.name: Gulhane Park
gulhane-park.tip: A quiet green break next to Topkapi. Good for a picnic or a rest between sights.
gulhane-park.best: Spring for the tulips; any sunny day

istanbul-aquarium.name: Istanbul Aquarium
istanbul-aquarium.price_text: Paid entry; check on the day
istanbul-aquarium.hours: Daily, roughly 10:00–20:00 — check on the day
istanbul-aquarium.tip: Good for families and rainy days. It is far from the old city — allow travel time.

kadikoy-market.name: Kadıköy Market streets
kadikoy-market.price_text: Free to browse; pay for what you eat
kadikoy-market.hours: Daily, busiest late morning to evening
kadikoy-market.tip: Eat your way through the market streets — cheese, olives, and fresh fish. Cheaper than the tourist side.

pierre-loti.name: Pierre Loti viewpoint
pierre-loti.price_text: Free; cable car costs a small fare
pierre-loti.tip: Take the cable car up and walk down through the old cemetery for the Golden Horn view.

istiklal-walk.name: İstiklal Avenue walk
istiklal-walk.hours: Always open; liveliest in the evening
istiklal-walk.tip: Walk from Taksim down to Galata. Watch your bag in the crowds.

turkish-bath.name: Historic Turkish bath (hamam)
turkish-bath.price_text: Entry plus scrub varies widely; check on the day
turkish-bath.hours: Daily, usually morning to late evening
turkish-bath.tip: Book ahead and bring a swimsuit. Men and women are usually separate or on different hours.

ortakoy-walk.name: Ortaköy waterfront walk
ortakoy-walk.hours: Always open; stalls daytime to evening
ortakoy-walk.tip: Try a baked potato (kumpir) and watch the bridge light up at sunset.
